name: Kazue Saitou
source:
Kazue suffers from lupus, a chronic auto-immune disease that is debilitating and difficult to manage, and her physical illness takes a toll on her mental state. Often she is upset by small things because of underlying pain and fatigue. She hides these hardships from others with a smile and doesn’t want people to worry about her. She desperately wants to be useful and will work even when having a flare-up.

Do not be fooled: underneath her sweet smile, Kazue is manipulative, using sexual favors as a bargaining chip to get what she wants. Pushing her away may cause more harm than good, so tread carefully. She can be very aggressive with her affection and will not accept “no” for an answer.

[From strategy guide]
